cards.title: Set SQLite busy_timeout before lock-prone startup pragmas
cards.why_relevant: When changing SQLite connection startup, WAL mode, schema initialization, migrations, or concurrent CLI/agent database access in codetrap.
cards.avoid: Setting PRAGMA busy_timeout after PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL, initSchema, migrations, or other startup database work means an existing startup lock can fail immediately with database is locked before the timeout is active.
